The image shows soybean seeds held in a hand. Several seeds display distinct purple/violet discoloration — some partially stained, some heavily stained. The background seed color is the normal tan/cream. This is a seed symptom, not a leaf or stem symptom.

Purple discoloration on soybean seeds is the hallmark of **Purple Seed Stain**, caused by *Cercospora kikuchii*. The pattern here — irregular purple blotches on otherwise normal-colored seeds — is a textbook presentation of this condition.
